prompt: In the main Postfix configuration file, how are service definitions continued on the next line?
choices: The initial line must end with a backslash (`\\`)
The definition continues until all required fields are specified
The following line must begin with whitespace indentation
It is not possible; the definition must fit on one line
The following line must begin with a plus character (`+`)
explanation: In Postfix configuration files a continuation line is indicated by starting it with whitespace.
